text.ms:
1.  Aktiviti yang dijalankan oleh—

(a) bank Labuan yang menjalankan perniagaan—

(i) menerima deposit untuk akaun semasa,
akaun deposit, akaun simpanan atau apa-apa akaun
lain sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh
Lembaga Perkhidmatan Kewangan Labuan;

(ii) perbankan pelaburan Labuan tidak termasuk
perniagaan kredit bangunan, perniagaan tanda kredit
dan perniagaan pemfaktoran;

(iii) kewangan Labuan yang berhubungan dengan
perniagaan pembiayaan pembangunan, perniagaan
pemajakan, perniagaan broker  wang, perniagaan
kewangan pembangunan Islam, perniagaan
pemajakan Islam  atau perniagaan pembrokeran
wang Islam;

(iv) perbankan Islam Labuan tidak termasuk perniagaan
kredit pembinaan Islam, perniagaan tanda kredit
Islam dan perniagaan pemfaktoran Islam;

(b) bank pelaburan Labuan yang menjalankan perniagaan—

(i) memberikan kemudahan kredit;

(ii) khidmat perundingan dan nasihat yang berhubungan
dengan perkara -perkara korporat dan pelaburan
termasuk berurus niaga sekuriti atau pembuatan
dan pengurusan pelaburan bagi pihak mana -mana
orang;

(iii) transaksi pertukaran  asing, swap kadar faedah,
urus niaga surat cara terbitan atau surat cara
kewangan terbitan atau mana-mana aktiviti
pengurusan risiko serupa itu yang lain;

(iv) perbankan pelaburan Islam L abuan tidak termasuk
perniagaan kredit pembinaan Islam, perniagaan
tanda kredit Islam dan perniagaan pemfaktoran
Islam;

(v) kewangan Labuan  yang berhubungan dengan
perniagaan pembiayaan pembangunan , perniagaan
pemajakan, perniagaan broker wang , perniagaan
kewangan pembangunan Islam , perniagaan
pemajakan Islam atau perniagaan pembrokeran
wang Islam;

(c) institusi berlesen Labuan yang menjalankan perniagaan
kewangan Labuan yang berhubungan dengan  perniagaan
pembiayaan pembangunan, perniagaan pemajakan,
perniagaan broker wang, perniagaan kewangan
pembangunan Islam , perniagaan pemajakan Islam atau
perniagaan pembrokeran wang Islam;

(d) penanggung insuran Labuan dan penanggung insuran
semula Labuan yang menjalankan perniagaan insurans
nyawa atau perniagaan insurans semula nyawa;

(e) penanggung insurans Labuan yang menjalankan perniagaan
insurans kaptif nyawa atau perniagaan insurans semula
kaptif nyawa;

(f) broker insurans Labuan ber hubung dengan perniagaan
insurans nyawa atau insurans semula nyawa;

(g) pengurus dana awam;

(h) pemegang lesen sekuriti;

(i) syarikat amanah Labuan; dan

(j) syarikat amanah diurus Labuan,

sebagaimana yang ditakrifkan atau diperuntukkan di bawah
Akta Perkhidmatan Kewangan dan Sekuriti Labuan 2010 [Akta 704].

2. Aktiviti yang dijalankan oleh—

(a) bank Islam Labuan yang menjalankan perniagaan—

(i) menerima deposit atas akaun semasa, akaun deposit,
akaun simpanan atau apa-apa akaun lain yang
mematuhi prinsip Syariah sebagaimana yang
ditentukan oleh Lembaga Perkhidmatan Kewangan
Labuan;

(ii) perbankan pelaburan Islam Labuan tidak termasuk
perniagaan kredit pembinaan Islam, perniagaan
tanda kredit Islam dan perniagaan pemfaktoran
Islam;

(iii) kewangan Islam Labuan yang berhubungan dengan
perniagaan kewangan pembangunan Islam,
perniagaan pemajakan Islam atau perniagaan
pembrokeran wang Islam;
(b) bank pelaburan Islam Labuan  yang menjalankan
perniagaan—

(i) memberikan kemudahan pembiayaan yang
mematuhi prinsip Syariah;

(ii) perkhidmatan perundingan dan penasihat yang
berhubungan dengan perkara korporat dan
pelaburan termasuk berurus niaga dalam sekuriti
atau pembuatan dan pengurusan pelaburan ,
bagi pihak mana -mana orang, yang mematuhi
prinsip Syariah;

(iii) transaksi pertukaran wang asing, swap kadar
keuntungan, berurus niaga surat cara terbitan Islam
atau surat cara kewangan terbitan Islam yang
mematuhi prinsip Syariah atau apa -apa aktiviti
pengurusan risiko serupa yang lain;

(iv) kewangan Islam  Labuan yang berhubungan dengan
perniagaan kewangan pembangunan Islam ,
perniagaan pemajakan Islam atau  perniagaan
pembrokeran wang Islam;

(c) institusi berlesen Islam Labuan yang menjalankan
perniagaan kewangan Islam Labuan yang berhubungan
dengan perniagaan kewangan  pembangunan Islam ,
perniagaan pemajakan Islam atau perniagaan pembrokeran
wang Islam;

(d) pengendali takaful Labuan dan takaful semula Labuan yang
menjalankan perniagaan takaful keluarga  atau
takaful semula keluarga;
(e) pengendali takaful dan takaful semula Labuan yang
menjalankan perniagaan takaful kaptif keluarga atau takaful
semula kaptif keluarga;

(f) broker takaful Labuan berhubung dengan perniagaan
takaful keluarga atau takaful semula keluarga;

(g) pengurus dana awam Islam; dan

(h) pemegang lesen sekuriti Islam,

sebagaimana yang ditakrifkan atau  diperuntukkan di bawah
Akta Perkhidmatan Kewangan dan Sekuriti Islam Labuan 2010 [Akta 705].

3. Aktiviti yang dijalankan oleh bursa yang diluluskan di bawah
seksyen 134 Akta Perkhidmatan Kewangan dan Sekuriti Labuan 2010
[Akta 704].".

DATUK SERI AMIR HAMZAH BIN AZIZAN
Menteri Kewangan II

ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING, ANTI-TERRORISM FINANCING
AND PROCEEDS OF UNLAWFUL ACTIVITIES ACT 2001

ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING, ANTI-TERRORISM FINANCING AND PROCEEDS OF
UNLAWFUL ACTIVITIES (AMENDMENT OF FIRST AND SECOND SCHEDULES)
ORDER 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 85 of the
Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Terrorism Financing and Proceeds of Unlawful Activities
Act 2001 [Act 613], the Minister of Finance makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Terrorism
Financing and Proceeds of Unlawful Activities (Amendment of First
and Second Schedules) Order 2024.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 15 June 2024.

Amendment of First Schedule
2. The Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Terrorism Financing and Proceeds of Unlawful
Activities Act 2001 , which is referred to as the "principal Act" in this O rder,
is amended in the First Schedule—

(a) in Part I—

(i) in paragraph 4—

(A) by deleting the word "or" at the end of paragraph (b);

(B) by substituting for the comma at the end of paragraph (c)
the words "; or"; and

(C) by inserting after paragraph (c) the following paragraph:

"(d) advising in corporate finance,"; and
(ii) by inserting after paragraph 24 the following paragraph:

" 24A. Activities of dealing in precious metals or precious
stones carried out by—

(a) businesses registered under the Business
Names Ordinance of Sarawak (Chapter 64) and
licensed under the Business , Professions and
Trades Licensing Ordinance of Sarawak
(Chapter 33);

(b) businesses licensed under the Trade Licensing
Ordinance of Sabah (Chapter 144); and

(c) limited liability partnerships registered under
the Limited Liability Partnership Act 2012
[Act 743]."; and

(b) by substituting for Part II the following part:

"PART II

1. Activities carried out by—

(a) Labuan bank carrying on the business of—

(i) receiving deposits on current account, deposit
account, savings account or any other account
as may be specified by the Labuan Financial Services
Authority;

(ii) Labuan investment banking  excluding building
credit business, credit token business and factoring
business;

(iii) Labuan financial business relating to  the
development finance business, leasing business ,
money-broking business, Islamic development
finance business, Isla mic leasing business or
Islamic money-broking business;

(iv) Labuan Islamic banking  excluding Islamic building
credit business, Islamic credit token business and
Islamic factoring business;

(b) Labuan investment bank carrying on the business of—

(i) providing credit facilities;

(ii) consultancy and advisory services relating to
corporate and investment matters  including dealing
in securities or making and managing investments
on behalf of any person;

(iii) undertaking foreign exchange transactions, interest
rate swaps, dealings in derivative instruments or
derivative financial instruments or any other simi lar
risk management activities;

(iv) Labuan Islamic investment banking excluding
Islamic building credit business, Islamic credit token
business and Islamic factoring business;

(v) Labuan financial  business relating to the
development finance business, leasing business ,
money-broking business, Islamic development
finance business, Islamic leasing business or
Islamic money-broking business;

(c) Labuan licensed institutions carrying on Labuan financial
business relating to  development finance business,
leasing business, money -broking business,
Islamic development finance business , Islamic leasing
business or Islamic money-broking business;

(d) Labuan insurer and reinsurer carrying on life insurance
business or life reinsurance business;

(e) Labuan insurer carrying on captive life insurance
or captive life reinsurance business;

(f) Labuan insurance broker in relation to life insurance or
life reinsurance business;

(g) fund manager of a public fund;

(h) securities licensee;

(i) Labuan trust company; and

(j) Labuan managed trust company,

as defined or provided under the Labuan Financial Services and Securities
Act 2010 [Act 704].

2. Activities carried out by—

(a) Labuan Islamic bank carrying on the business of—

(i) receiving deposits on current account,
deposit account, savings account or any other account
in compliance with S yariah principles as may be
specified by the Labuan Financial Services Authority;

(ii) Labuan Islamic investment banking excluding
Islamic building credit business, Islamic credit token
business and Islamic factoring business;

(iii) Labuan I slamic financial business relating to
Islamic development finance business, Islamic leasing
business or Islamic money-broking business;

(b) Labuan Islamic investment bank  carrying on  the business
of—

(i) providing financing facilities in compliance with
Syariah principles;

(ii) consultancy and advisory services relating to
corporate and investment matters including dealing
in securities or making and managing investments ,
on behalf of any person, in compliance with S yariah
principles;

(iii) undertaking foreign exchange transactions,
profit rate swaps, dealings in Islamic derivative
instruments or Islamic derivative financial
instruments which are in compliance with S yariah
principles or any other similar risk management
activities;

(iv) Labuan Isla mic financial relating to  Islamic
development finance business, Islamic leasing
business or Islamic money-broking business;

(c) Labuan Islamic licensed institution carrying on
Labuan Islamic financial business relating to
Islamic development finance business, Islamic leasing
business or Islamic money-broking business;

(d) Labuan takaful and retakaful operator carrying on
family takaful or family retakaful business;

(e) Labuan takaful  and retakaful  operator carrying on captive
family takaful or family retakaful business;

(f) Labuan takaful broker in relation to  family takaful or
family retakaful business;

(g) fund manager of an Islamic public fund; and

(h) Islamic securities licensee,

as defined or provided under the Labuan Islamic Financial Services and
Securities Act 2010 [Act 705].

3. Activities carried out by an exchange approved under section 134
of the Labuan Financial Services and Securities Act 2010 [Act 704].".
